title: Active Directory RID & Group-Provisioning Capacity Assessment
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (AD architecture capacity assessment + authorization-design review; read-only diagnostics + methodology).
White-label, vendor-neutral AD architecture methodology; no customer names or customer-specific numbers.
hook: Prove your AD group-provisioning model scales — before you turn it on
problem: Automated provisioning that creates several Active Directory security groups per project (read/write/privileged) can quietly threaten directory scalability — and teams reach for the wrong worry. This assessment answers the real question: is the proposed group-provisioning model sustainable long-term? It measures true RID-pool consumption and projects its lifetime, then evaluates the risks that actually bite at scale — Kerberos token bloat, group sprawl and lifecycle debt, replication and administrative overhead — and reviews the authorization architecture (AGDLP, RBAC, nesting) against Microsoft best practices, so you approve or redesign with evidence, not guesswork.
whats_inside: Assessment Overview — how RIDs, the RID Master, and the per-domain pool actually work (why deleted objects don't return RIDs), what really drives consumption, and the decision this assessment supports (an architectural go/no-go with conditions).
Inputs & Requirements — what you need to run it (AD read access, RID Master health, the provisioning rate and group-per-project count) with how to verify each.

Assessment Methodology — measure current RID consumption, project the pool lifetime (app-only and blended-org), evaluate the non-RID risks (token bloat, sprawl/lifecycle, replication/GC, backup, admin), and review the authorization model (AGDLP vs. flatten, RBAC/nesting to bound object growth).

5 PowerShell scripts — RID-pool consumption & RID Master health, project-group growth & orphan report, Kerberos token-size exposure for high-membership principals, AGDLP/nesting validator, and a lifecycle-cleanup preview (safe, read-only by default).

Recommendations, Guardrails & a reusable Assessment Report template — conditions-of-approval (lifecycle automation, dedicated OU + naming standard, ownership metadata, RID/token/orphan monitoring), plus Testing/Troubleshooting and field-proven Best Practices.
short: A repeatable Active Directory capacity assessment for per-project group-provisioning models — measure real RID consumption, project the pool lifetime, and evaluate the risks that actually matter (token bloat, sprawl, lifecycle) with an AGDLP/RBAC design review. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
